title: Concept: CSS expression function in inline style
description: A style attribute that calls the legacy expression function in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The function evaluates JavaScript in old rendering engines and, more importantly, its presence shows that a style value is being built from untrusted data without a property allowlist.
applicability: Deployments that render a style attribute that calls the legacy expression function into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The function evaluates JavaScript in old rendering engines and, more importantly, its presence shows that a style value is being built from untrusted data without a property allowlist.
